name: Whispering Shore
summary: Along Tirisfal Glades' western coast, the Whispering Shore lies north of Solliden Farmstead, its waters claimed by hostile murlocs.

sections.title: A Ruined Haven
sections.body: Before the Third War, Lordaeron's fishermen came to the Whispering Shore for calm waters and plentiful catches. Now the Great Sea breaks against an empty coast, and the water is cold and dark. Travelers coming down from the hills risk an ambush from the murlocs along the shore.

sections.title: The Murloc Menace
sections.body: A band of hostile murlocs claims the beach and attacks anyone who approaches the surf. Their chieftain, Muad, leads them as they guard the shallows and tidal flats, threatening nearby roads and Solliden Farmstead.

faq.q: Where is the Whispering Shore located?
faq.answer: The Whispering Shore runs along Tirisfal Glades' western coast, directly north of Solliden Farmstead.

faq.q: What used to be at the Whispering Shore before the Scourge?
aliases: what was whispering shore used for
faq.answer: Before the Scourge, local fishermen came to the shore for its calm waters and plentiful catches.

faq.q: Who controls the Whispering Shore now?
faq.answer: A hostile tribe of murlocs controls the coastline under the leadership of Muad, their chieftain. They attack anyone who approaches the water.

faq.q: Can you still fish peacefully at the Whispering Shore?
faq.answer: No. The shore has lost its peaceful character, and hostile murlocs guard its cold, dark waters, where the catches are no longer plentiful.

angles.text: As Forsaken securing western Tirisfal Glades, you face an unruly murloc threat along the edge of your holdings at Whispering Shore.
